description: MetaRalph Phases 14-18: Branch isolation for parallel execution, manual queue priority, worker observability, project browser, task dependencies, cost tracking, failure intelligence, GitHub integration, scheduling, remote execution, debug mode, hot-reload with versioning, and project health dashboard.

userStories.title: Implement branch-per-task isolation
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to execute each task on its own git branch so multiple tasks can run in parallel without conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: ralph-spawner.ts updated to checkout task branch before execution
Tasks table has branch_name, merge_strategy, merged_at columns
On task completion, branch auto-merges to base (if strategy=auto)
On task failure, branch is preserved for debugging

userStories.title: Implement merge coordinator for completed branches
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to handle merging completed task branches back to the base branch.
acceptanceCriteria: Detects merge conflicts before attempting merge
For strategy=auto: merge immediately on success
For strategy=manual: queue for user approval in dashboard
For strategy=pr: create GitHub PR via MCP tools

userStories.title: Add manual priority control to queue
userStories.description: As a user, I need to manually override task priority so I can control execution order.
acceptanceCriteria: Tasks table has manual_priority column (nullable integer)
CLI: metaralph queue priority <task-id> <score> sets priority

userStories.title: Add priority controls to dashboard QueueView
userStories.description: As a user, I need to adjust task priority from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: QueueView.tsx: p key opens priority input for exact value
Visual indicator (star or badge) for manually-prioritized tasks
Priority changes persist immediately to database

userStories.title: Implement worker output capture
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to capture Claude Code's full output for each Ralph iteration.
acceptanceCriteria: src/workers/output-capture.ts captures stdout/stderr from Ralph process
ralph-spawner.ts uses pipe instead of ignore for stdio
Database iterations table stores per-iteration output
Output truncated if exceeds 1MB per iteration

userStories.title: Create iterations table and tracker
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track each Ralph loop iteration with detailed metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: src/workers/iteration-tracker.ts parses Ralph output to detect iteration boundaries
Tracks: iteration_number, story_id, files_changed, commits, duration_seconds
Extracts summary and thinking from Claude output
Links iterations to executions via execution_id

userStories.title: Add WorkerDetailView with live output streaming
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see live Claude Code output for running workers.
acceptanceCriteria: Select worker from WorkersView, press Enter to see details
Auto-scrolls to bottom, Space to pause scrolling
Shows iteration progress: Iteration 3/10 - Working on US-045

userStories.title: Implement metaralph watch and logs commands
userStories.description: As a user, I need CLI commands to view worker output.
acceptanceCriteria: metaralph watch <task-id> tails live output for active worker
metaralph logs <execution-id> shows historical execution logs
Output formatted with timestamps and iteration markers

userStories.title: Implement directory scanner for project browser
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to scan directories and detect projects.
acceptanceCriteria: src/registry/project-detector.ts detects project type by markers
Returns DetectedProject with type, gitStatus, readme preview
Skips node_modules, .git, and other common ignore patterns

userStories.title: Create ProjectBrowser component for dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I need to browse my filesystem and add projects from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Arrow keys navigate, Enter drills down, Backspace goes up
Projects shown with type badge and registration status
a key adds highlighted project to MetaRalph
/ key opens path input for quick jump
Preview pane shows README and git info for selected project

userStories.title: Add multi-select and group creation to ProjectBrowser
userStories.description: As a user, I need to select multiple projects and create groups.
acceptanceCriteria: Space toggles selection on current item
g key creates group from selected projects, prompts for name
f key toggles favorite/bookmark on directory
Favorites stored in config and shown at top of browser

userStories.title: Implement task dependencies system
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need tasks to declare dependencies on other tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Database migration adds task_dependencies table (task_id, depends_on_id)
TaskRepository extended with addDependency, removeDependency, getDependencies
Circular dependency detection throws clear error

userStories.title: Implement dependency-aware scheduler
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need the scheduler to respect task dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Task states: waiting (deps incomplete), ready (deps done), blocked (dep failed)
getNextTasks only returns tasks with all dependencies complete
If dependency fails, dependent tasks marked as blocked

userStories.title: Add DependencyGraph visualization to dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see task dependencies visually.
acceptanceCriteria: Accessible from queue view with d key on selected task
metaralph task graph <id> shows CLI version

userStories.title: Implement cost tracking database and calculator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track token usage and calculate costs.
acceptanceCriteria: src/costs/calculator.ts converts tokens to USD using pricing config
Pricing config in ~/.config/metaralph/config.json with per-model rates

userStories.title: Implement budget management and alerts
userStories.description: As a user, I need to set spending budgets with automatic actions.
acceptanceCriteria: Actions on limit: warn, pause (stop scheduling), stop (kill workers)

userStories.title: Add CostDashboard component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see cost breakdowns in the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays: today, this week, this month totals
Bar chart by project showing percentage of spend
Top tasks by cost with iteration counts
Budget progress bar with limit indicator
metaralph costs CLI shows same data

userStories.title: Implement failure recording and clustering
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to capture failures and group similar ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Database migrations add failure_records and failure_clusters tables
Records: error_type, error_message, stack_trace, context JSON
Auto-creates cluster when pattern matches 3+ failures

userStories.title: Implement fix suggester and smart retry
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to suggest fixes and retry with adjusted prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: src/learning/fix-suggester.ts recommends fixes from cluster history
src/learning/retry-strategy.ts adjusts prompt based on failure type
Clusters store suggested_fix and auto_retry_strategy JSON
On retry, adds failure context to Ralph prompt
metaralph failures shows clusters with occurrence counts
metaralph failures analyze <execution-id> shows detailed failure

userStories.title: Implement GitHub PR manager
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to create pull requests from completed task branches.
acceptanceCriteria: src/github/pr-manager.ts creates PRs via MCP GitHub tools
PR description generated from task PRD and commits
metaralph pr create <task-id> creates PR manually

userStories.title: Implement GitHub issue synchronization
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to sync task status with GitHub issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Comments on issue when task starts and completes
Closes issue automatically when task completes (if configured)
Creates MetaRalph tasks from issues with specific labels
metaralph issues sync triggers manual sync

userStories.title: Implement cron-style task scheduling
userStories.description: As a user, I need to schedule recurring tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: metaralph schedule list shows all schedules with next run time

userStories.title: Implement webhook and trigger system
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to create tasks in response to external events.
acceptanceCriteria: metaralph triggers list shows active triggers

userStories.title: Implement remote execution coordinator
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to run Ralph workers on remote machines via SSH.
acceptanceCriteria: src/remote/sync.ts syncs code via git pull or rsync
Config: remote.machines array with host, user, keyPath, workDir

userStories.title: Implement task routing to remote machines
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to route tasks to local or remote based on effort.
acceptanceCriteria: Config: remote.routing.preferRemote (effort levels to send remote)
Config: remote.routing.preferLocal (effort levels to keep local)
Failover to local if remote unavailable
metaralph remote list shows machine status

userStories.title: Implement interactive debug mode
userStories.description: As a user, I need to pause a stuck task and intervene manually.
acceptanceCriteria: metaralph debug <task-id> opens interactive Claude Code with context
Debug session captures interventions as learnings

userStories.title: Add DebugView to dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I need to manage debug sessions from the dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows pause reason: manual, error, breakpoint
Shows context: current story, iteration, files modified
d key on running worker pauses it
r key on paused worker resumes it

userStories.title: Implement semantic versioning system
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to track my version and classify changes.
acceptanceCriteria: src/versioning/classifier.ts classifies git diffs by impact
MAJOR: schema changes, breaking API, removed features
MINOR: new commands, new features, new files

userStories.title: Implement hot-reload system
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to reload myself when my code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: State includes: queue position, active workers, dashboard state
Reload waits for workers to reach safe checkpoint
Re-execs daemon process with new code

userStories.title: Implement major version approval flow
userStories.description: As a user, I need to approve major version updates before they apply.
acceptanceCriteria: MAJOR version changes queued for approval, not auto-applied
metaralph update status shows pending updates
metaralph update approve applies pending major update
metaralph update reject discards pending update
5-minute stability window with auto-rollback on crash

userStories.title: Add version display and update UI to dashboard
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see version info and approve updates in dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: After update shows: Updated 2m ago (v1.2.2 → v1.2.3)
Shows diff summary, migration info, rollback availability
Approve/Reject buttons for pending major updates
metaralph update history shows version history

userStories.title: Implement project health analyzer
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to calculate health scores for projects.
acceptanceCriteria: Components: testCoverage, dependencyHealth, issueBacklog, buildStability, codeQuality
Health alerts with severity and recommendations

userStories.title: Add HealthDashboard component
userStories.description: As a user, I need to see project health at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Health bar visualization with score and trend arrow
Alert badges: security vulns, outdated deps, failing tests
Create fix tasks button for actionable alerts

userStories.title: Implement auto-generated improvement tasks from health
userStories.description: As MetaRalph, I need to create tasks automatically when projects become unhealthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Health analyzer can auto-create tasks for critical issues
Security vulnerabilities create high-priority bug_fix tasks
Config: health.thresholds for when to create tasks
Dashboard shows 'Apply All' for pending health recommendations
